name: Spot-confirmed favourite
description: Buys the favourite (YES or NO) once per market 8-10 minutes before close, only when spot is at least 2 sigma (15-min realized vol) past the strike. Spot-confirmed favourites win more often than the ~92c price implies.
hypothesis: Kalshi prices 8-10 min favourites off a flatter vol/noise assumption; when spot is >2 sigma from the strike the true win rate (~95%) beats the ask (~92c) by 2-3c after fees (BTC research +2.6c, se 0.7, 924 trades, 8/9 months; ETH positive). Other side: favourite-longshot payers. Wrong if the engine (150 ms, 13-contract depth) removes it, <60% months positive, or SOL-style decay (edge fading over months) shows.
